checks: Controlled code/PKCE login persists an opaque HttpOnly cookie and authoritative workspace
The same active cookie survives graceful restart and process crash without expiry extension
Independent BFF validates the shared cookie and enforces CSRF after restart
Concurrent cross-process workspace changes preserve authorized scope and reject foreign context
Atomic rotation invalidates the old token on both processes and changes session-bound CSRF
Logout persists revocation across the second process and subsequent restart
Suspended identity is rejected after restart and its observed invalid session stays revoked
Restart between authorization and callback preserves nonce, state and PKCE
Concurrent callback consumption succeeds once across actual BFF processes
Wrong browser state/binding and expired durable login transactions cannot establish a cookie
Crash after rotation persistence but before cookie delivery cannot revive the old token
